title: Doorprints sync file, doorprints-sync/1
description: The inner format of a device's sync file in Google Drive (S4b-BL-130, docs/15 §5.1), inside the dpx/1 envelope and gzipped. One file per device holds that device's whole state, tombstones included and kept for ever. The readers are SyncFiles.parse (android/shared, app.doorprints.shared.sync) and parseSyncFile (web/src/app/data/drive/sync-file.ts); they also check what a schema cannot: the whole file is at most 16 MiB of UTF-8, all four lists together hold at most 100000 rows, a key appears once per list, deviceId is the writer the envelope authenticated, and times are real calendar instants from 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z on. Unknown properties are ignored (a newer writer within /1). Rows carry the sync DTOs' other fields, which the sync loop validates like a server row.

seq.description: The writer's counter, raised by every write: a lower seq than one already merged from that device is a file rolled back by a Drive revision, and is not merged.

time.description: ISO-8601 UTC, 1 to 9 fraction digits (read to the millisecond), no offset, no leap second.

version.description: What the Drive merge compares: last write wins on updatedAt, then by (code units), then a tombstone above a live row; a row stamped more than 24 hours after the reader's clock is held until it is not.

record.description: RecordDto plus by; keyed by type and id.

photo.description: PhotoChangeDto plus by, and the Drive file of its bytes with their SHA-256.
